title: Case: Customer still has no printable label for an approved casserole set return
context: The merchant approved a return for a cast-iron casserole set but its label team has not issued the label. The approval lapses if no label is issued by the end of the month.
initial_request: Hello again. I wrote on Tuesday about the label for sending the casserole pots back and I have heard nothing and there is still nothing to print on my order page, I have looked three times today and had my son look as well in case it was me. The approval says it runs out on the 31st and I go to my sister's on Sunday for a fortnight so really it has to be posted by Saturday. Can you please either send me the label yourself or tell me it is definitely on its way so I can stop worrying about it. Juno

events.body: Return RT-9593 for order TG-2929 / shipment DL-7363 (cast-iron casserole set, 3 piece) is approved. No label has been issued yet. Labels are issued by our Return label team against the RT number; they take requests by email. The approval lapses on 2026-03-31 if no label has been issued by then, and a lapsed approval has to be re-applied for.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the label team by email to issue the label for RT-9593 / TG-2929 / DL-7363, noting the earlier portal request never reached them, the 2026-03-31 lapse and the customer's need to post by Saturday 2026-03-28.

must: Send the label request to the Return label team by Email
Quote return RT-9593 with order TG-2929 or shipment DL-7363
Mention the time limit: approval lapses 2026-03-31 and the customer needs the label in time to post by Saturday 2026-03-28
must_not: Tell the customer the label is on its way, has been requested or will arrive by a given day
Post the request again through the Business portal that rejected it
Produce, attach or describe a return label itself
Promise that the approval will be extended past 2026-03-31
Say or imply the return or a refund is already in progress
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Return RT-9593 for order TG-2929 (original shipment DL-7363, cast-iron casserole set) was approved by Returns authorisations on 2026-03-24, but the customer, Juno Quarrie, still has no printable label on his order. A request this desk posted through your Business portal on 2026-03-24 was rejected by the portal and never reached you, so this is the first time you are seeing it. Please issue the label against RT-9593 and send it to the customer in the verified returns thread. The approval lapses on 2026-03-31 and he is away from Sunday 2026-03-29, so he needs it in time to post by Saturday 2026-03-28. Please confirm once it is issued.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-202: people, organisations and references renamed. 4 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
